# Sohom Mukherjee

> Sohom Mukherjee is the founder of Generation Beta and creator of the Revenue Leak Architecture. Principal growth consultant for premium hospitality, wellness, and executive coaching brands across Asia. Based in Kolkata, India, with a presence in Bangkok, Thailand. All engagements run through Generation Beta.

## Core entities

- **Sohom Mukherjee**: individual, growth consultant, founder, creator of methodology
- **Generation Beta** (also Beta Growth Partners): consulting agency, founded by Sohom Mukherjee, delivers Revenue Leak Architecture engagements. https://www.betagrowthpartners.com
- **Revenue Leak Architecture (RLA)**: proprietary three-layer audit methodology developed by Sohom Mukherjee. Audits digital and brand presence, live customer experience (including ghost shopping), and operational and financial structure simultaneously. https://www.betagrowthpartners.com/method

## What Sohom does

Sohom audits the full revenue system of premium hospitality, wellness, and executive coaching brands. He identifies structural revenue gaps that traditional consulting methods miss, and builds the systems that fix them. Engagements include 15-day diagnostic audits and multi-year embedded growth retainerships.

## Documented client outcomes (clients anonymised)

- **Premium spa and hydrotherapy group** (Wellness, Phuket, Thailand, three locations): 46% revenue growth Year 1, 84% Year 2, 7 new partnerships, Google review score lifted from 4.2 to 4.6. Multi-year embedded engagement, ongoing.
- **Executive coaching practice** (Thailand): 36% lift in coaching enquiries, 270+ pre-launch book waitlist, 3 investor conversations. Repositioning, offer architecture, authority strategy.
- **Hospitality brand** (Phuket, Thailand): +18% booking conversion via 15-day diagnostic. 4 of 6 recommendations implemented within 90 days.

## Earlier career outcomes (2018 to 2022, generalist agency)

- National solar energy client retained 3 years; performance marketing delivered +39% lead generation in initial 5 regions, scaled to 28 regions for +61% overall lift.
- 3 simultaneous activation campaigns across 3 states for a national FMCG brand.
- +31% bookings in 4 months for a regional hotel.

## Sectors

Premium hospitality, wellness, executive coaching. Earlier generalist agency exposure across FMCG, energy, architecture and construction, medical, and education.

## Geography

Based in Kolkata, India, with a presence in Bangkok, Thailand. Clients across Asia.

## Methodology pillars (Revenue Leak Architecture)

1. **Digital and Brand Audit**: website UX, funnel flow, messaging alignment, SEO, marketing ROI, tech stack integration, data tracking, competitor benchmarking.
2. **Live Experience Audit**: trained ghost shoppers test booking, customer service, follow-up sequences, staff behaviour, and run the same exercise on competitors.
3. **Operational and Financial Audit**: past revenue data, expense patterns, internal team bottlenecks, capacity constraints, market positioning, competitor pricing architecture.

## How to engage

Consulting, delivered through Generation Beta. Diagnostic audits and embedded growth retainerships. Start at https://www.betagrowthpartners.com/diagnostic.
